Please also read the Information tab carefully to make sure you understand the COVID-safe requirements. Guests are limited to strictly one per competitor. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
